mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wa_group_invite ( tenant_id, group_id, invite_code, origin, health_status, banned, last_checked_at, last_error_code, failure_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{groupId}, #{inviteCode}, 5, 1, 0, #{observedAt}, NULL, 0, #{now}, #{now}, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_id = COALESCE(group_id, VALUES(group_id)), health_status = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(last_checked_at, 0) AND COALESCE(banned, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE health_status END, last_error_code = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(last_checked_at, 0) AND COALESCE(banned, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE last_error_code END, failure_count = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(last_checked_at, 0) AND COALESCE(banned, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE failure_count END, last_checked_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_checked_at, 0), VALUES(last_checked_at)), updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))
